autoFare.tips: Always insist on meter ('Meter se chalo bhaiya') or use Ola/Uber auto for reference.

commonScams.description: Drivers outside railway stations claim your hotel burned down or is under police curfew to steer you to a commission agent.
commonScams.howToAvoid: Never believe unsolicited hotel status claims. Call your hotel directly.
commonScams.fairPriceRef: Govt Prepaid booth is inside the terminal, not on the curb.

commonScams.description: Drivers claim their usual route is closed and take you to high-commission emporiums.
commonScams.howToAvoid: State firmly: 'Sirf direct destination jaana hai, koi dukaan nahi'.

autoFare.tips: Autos rarely use meters in the old city. Fix fare before boarding: ₹80-₹120 covers most city spots.

commonScams.description: Friendly strangers ask tourists to carry 'duty-free gemstones' promising high resale returns.
commonScams.howToAvoid: Strictly fraudulent. Never purchase stones for resale.
commonScams.fairPriceRef: Buy only from Govt approved RTDC emporiums.

autoFare.tips: E-rickshaws cost ₹15-₹30 for shared rides between Godowlia and Assi Ghat.

commonScams.description: Boatmen charge ₹2,000-₹4,000 for a 45-min Aarti view.
commonScams.howToAvoid: Fair rate is ₹100-₹200 per seat on shared motor boats.
commonScams.fairPriceRef: Book early afternoon directly at Dashashwamedh or Assi Ghat steps.

autoFare.tips: Prepaid auto booth available at Agra Cantt station platform 1.

commonScams.description: Selling cheap chalk/soapstone souvenirs at genuine marble inlay prices.
commonScams.howToAvoid: Real marble is cold to touch, scratch-resistant, and translucent under phone flashlight.

bargainingPhrases.tip: Say with confident, friendly tone before stepping into the vehicle.

bargainingPhrases.english: That is too high. What is the fair price?
bargainingPhrases.hindi: Yeh bahut zyada hai. Sahi rate kya hai?
bargainingPhrases.tamil: Idhu romba adhigam. Sariyaana vilai enna?
bargainingPhrases.bengali: Eta khub beshi. Sothik daam ta bolun?
bargainingPhrases.tip: Usually offers are 20-30% negotiable in open bazaars.
